title: Claude's Personal Finance beta can read a US bank account. It cannot move the money
friendlyTitle: Claude can read a US bank account in a new test. It cannot move the money
summary: Anthropic is rolling out Personal Finance in Claude this week, in beta, on the Pro, Max, and Ultra plans in the United States. You connect a bank or card account yourself through Plaid. Claude does not ask for or see the bank password. Access is read-only: Anthropic says Personal Finance cannot move, manage, or invest money, and it is not designed to give investment advice. For the accounts you connect, Claude sees the bank name, each account's name, type, and last four digits, balances and credit limits, and up to two years of transactions. You can ask where the money went, whether a category is higher than usual, or whether a charge hit twice. Chats inside the Personal Finance hub are not used to train Anthropic's models. Chats outside the hub follow your ordinary privacy settings. You can unlink an account, and Claude then loses that data. Anthropic says Claude can still be wrong, and that important figures should be checked with the bank.
